# WIPLabs

WIPLabs is a platform engineering and mobile development studio run by İhsan Özlü, a Senior DevOps Engineer based in Istanbul, Turkey. WIPLabs offers fixed-price DevOps consulting services (Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure) and builds native iOS and Android apps.

## Developer

- Name: İhsan Özlü
- Role: Senior DevOps Engineer, Platform Engineering Consultant & Mobile Developer
- Location: Istanbul, Turkey
- Contact: hello@wiplabs.app
- GitHub: https://github.com/ihsanozlu
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/ihsan-özlü-32081a116
- Background: 8+ years in cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes (AKS, EKS, Rancher), Terraform, Azure, AWS, CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions), observability (Grafana, Prometheus, Loki). Also builds native iOS (SwiftUI) and Android (Kotlin) apps using MVVM architecture.

## Services

WIPLabs offers fixed-price DevOps and platform engineering services for startups and growing companies. All services have a defined scope, fixed price, and are delivered within days.

### Architecture Call
- Price: $99
- What: 1-hour Zoom consultation, written summary and recommendations
- Delivered: same day
- Contact: hello@wiplabs.app

### Kubernetes Health Audit
- Price: $399
- What: Full cluster security review, performance and resource analysis, cost optimization report, PDF report, 1-hour walkthrough call
- Delivered: 3 business days
- Contact: hello@wiplabs.app

### CI/CD Pipeline Setup
- Price: $699
- What: GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps pipeline with Docker build, automated deployment, rollback strategy, documentation
- Delivered: 5 business days
- Contact: hello@wiplabs.app

### Terraform Infrastructure
- Price: $999
- What: VPC/networking, Kubernetes cluster (AKS or EKS), monitoring stack, all code in a private GitHub repo, full documentation
- Delivered: 7 business days
- Contact: hello@wiplabs.app

### Monitoring Stack
- Price: $1,299
- What: Grafana + Prometheus + Loki + Alertmanager, custom dashboards, alert rules, runbook documentation, handoff call
- Delivered: 5 business days
- Contact: hello@wiplabs.app

### Monthly Retainer
- Starter: $800/month — 4hrs/month, infrastructure review, Slack support
- Growth: $1,500/month — 8hrs/month, Terraform + Kubernetes + CI/CD + monitoring support
- Contact: hello@wiplabs.app

### Mobile App Development
- iOS MVP (SwiftUI, App Store submission): from $2,500
- iOS + Android MVP (native, both stores): from $4,500
- Contact: hello@wiplabs.app

### Full Services Page
- URL: https://wiplabs.app/services

## Apps

### Trace Order
- Platforms: iOS, Android
- Status: Live
- Page: https://wiplabs.app/apps/trace-order
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/tr/app/siparis-takip/id6754329960
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ihsanozlu.badeorder
- Description: A mobile app for small businesses to track customer orders, delivery status, and front-end accounting. Built from real family business experience. Supports Turkish, English, and Spanish.

### Bade Daily List
- Platforms: iOS
- Status: Live
- Page: https://wiplabs.app/apps/bade-daily-list
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/tr/app/bade-günlük-ürün-listesi/id6742989209
- Description: A daily product list generator for small retail and bakery businesses. Add products once, then generate and share a fresh list every day in seconds. Built for Bade Pastanesi, a family bakery in Istanbul.

### Gratefuly Journal
- Platforms: iOS, Android
- Status: Live
- Page: https://wiplabs.app/apps/gratefuly
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/gratefuly-journal/id6760760312
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ihsanozlu.gratefuly
- Description: A private daily gratitude journal and mood diary. Features daily writing prompts, mood tracking, streaks, and rich media entries (photos, voice recordings, videos). Everything stays on-device — no account required, no cloud uploads. Available in English, Turkish, and Spanish.

### OpsCanary
- Platform: Web
- Status: Live
- Page: https://wiplabs.app/apps/opscanary
- URL: https://opscanary.com
- Description: A daily DevOps learning platform delivering curated technical content from official AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, and Terraform documentation. 3–5 original AI-authored articles per day capped at 30 minutes, scenario-based quizzes with practical YAML/Terraform/kubectl challenges, and free browser utilities (JWT decoder, CIDR calculator, YAML converter). Covers 10 pillars: Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, GCP, Terraform, CI/CD, Observability, DevSecOps, Platform Engineering, Data Infrastructure. Free, no sign-up required to browse. Optional daily email digest subscription available.

### SGEO Digital
- Platform: Web
- Status: Live
- Page: https://wiplabs.app/apps/sgeodigital
- URL: https://sgeodigital.com
- Description: A web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) agency helping businesses rank on Google and get cited by AI search engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI. Based in Kayseri, Turkey, serving Turkish and international clients. Services include web design, SEO, GEO optimization, and e-commerce. Fully bilingual (Turkish and English).

### HukukAI
- Platforms: iOS (Android coming soon)
- Status: Live
- Page: https://wiplabs.app/apps/hukukai
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/tr/app/hukukai/id6761995890
- Description: An AI-powered Turkish law exam preparation app. Covers Adli Hakimlik, HMGS, and other Turkish legal profession exams. Includes 5000+ questions across 11 law codes (TMK, TBK, TCK, CMK, HMK, and more), scenario-mode questions, exam simulation, topic-level analytics, and a national leaderboard. In Turkish.
